scene_randomization.distribution_rationale: Six-sphere dense-z double-hourglass law in the PRE2 taskspace z=[0.1,1.7]. The longitudinal support [0.20,0.80] reserves endpoint space. Sphere centers are symmetric about z=0.9 and clipped to [0.7,1.1]; the hourglass half-width profile remains tighter near its pinch. The goal-side y minimum is moved from -1.7 to -2.1 m so the goal-to-y-min clearance is 0.6 m.
scene_randomization.geometry_contract: Six 15-inch physical spheres (radius 0.1905 m), each inflated by robot radius 0.05 m to modeled radius 0.2405 m. Modeled surfaces have at least 0.20 m clearance, hence center distance is at least 2*0.2405+0.20=0.681 m. H_P context and NVP safety consume the same modeled sphere rows and taskspace bounds.

taskspace_rationale: Causal goal-side boundary intervention only: y_min moves from -1.7 to -2.1 m while x_max remains 1.3 m. The goal-to-wall clearances are exactly 0.6 m at both y_min and x_max. The z taskspace, start, goal, scene law, sphere geometry, and every SafeMPPI parameter are unchanged. taskspace.origin/size and safety.safe_min/safe_max encode the same bounds, so H_P context, full-polytope verification, execution wall cost, and OOB termination all see y_min=-2.1 m.
